name: UploadFoldersToFtp
label: Upload Folder(s) to FTP
description: Uploads one or more local folders to a remote FTP/FTPS server.

fields.name: FtpConnection
fields.label: FTP Connection
fields.description: The FtpClient object representing an open connection to an FTP server.

fields.name: LocalFolders
fields.label: Local Folders
fields.description: The list of local folder paths to upload.

fields.name: RemoteDirectory
fields.label: Remote Directory
fields.description: The remote directory where folders should be uploaded.

fields.name: OverwriteFiles
fields.label: Overwrite Files
fields.description: If true, overwrites existing files on the server.

fields.name: IncludeSubDirectories
fields.label: Include Subdirectories
fields.description: If true, uploads all subdirectories recursively.

fields.name: TimeoutSeconds
fields.label: Timeout Seconds
fields.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait before failing due to timeout.

fields.name: FoldersUploadedCount
fields.label: Folders Uploaded Count
fields.description: Returns the number of folders successfully uploaded.

fields.name: FilesUploadedCount
fields.label: Files Uploaded Count
fields.description: Returns the total number of files uploaded.

fields.name: SkippedFiles
fields.label: Skipped Files
fields.description: Returns the list of files that were skipped during upload.

fields.name: SkippedFolders
fields.label: Skipped Folders
fields.description: Returns the list of folders that were skipped during upload.
